blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A Cebu-based graduate secured a spot among the country’s topnotchers in the November 2026 Nutritionist-Dietitian Licensure Examination (NDLE), earning ninth place with a rating of 94.40 percent. Alyssa Adelle Eguia Dalumpines ranked among the 19 examinees who reached the PRC’s top 10 list, becoming the lone Cebu-based graduate to earn a spot in the national rankings. She shared ninth place with Alyssa Ysabelle Datingaling De Villa of the University of the Philippines-Los Baños, who also scored 94.40 percent.
